title: Offline local LLM for a multiplayer tabletop RPG mode
author: skippydev
selftext:
Hey everyone, I'm a full-time programmer in the games industry for over 10+ years now, and I've been working during my free time outside of work with one other person who is a veteran 3D character artist on a game that is centered around an extremely detailed 3D character creator and a multiplayer chat/chill experience.

I wanted to share some footage of our multiplayer turn-based tabletop RPG mini-game as it is finally coming together. There's optional life-like TTS narration that's supposed to be coming out of an NPC but that 3D model isn't ready yet so I muted the game for this demo video. There's a lot more I'm looking to add, like chatting with NPCs in the stories, modifying your gear and stats, and more settings and options for the scenario. I'm honestly really pleased with the results so far but there's still a lot of polish and clean up work I need to do before launching early access at the end of this month. I'd love to hear people's thoughts on all this based on the video shown above.

Over the last few months I started experimenting with running a local small LLM and TTS models in our game to see how far we can take our handcrafted game with the help of AI. So I made a conversation engine and now this tabletop mode, the conversation feature in itself even inspired the game's concept trailer up on Steam. We plan on releasing the game as free to play, with cosmetic purchases in the Steam store if you want unique clothing. If you're interested to see more we have a Steam page up here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4475880/Confide/
